Frequently asked questions

Which POS software do you install?

Our own SELLO POS for shops and restaurants, and SELLO Lite, an offline POS app for Android phones and tablets.

Do you supply the POS machines too?

Yes. We supply complete POS systems — hardware and software from one supplier, installed and supported.

Does it work without internet?

Yes. SELLO runs on your own shop network, so billing, stock and reports keep working offline.
